title: I do love the length, teal color and design.
text: I do love the length, teal color and design.. Unfortunately this rug turns up on 2 corners. May be due to cheaper quality though the length, design and colors work for me.  I’m hoping I can find a fix for the corners that turn up as they may be a tripping hazard.
